Pray Farmstead(s)
The east silo is constructed of precast concrete staves that are reinforced by tightened metal hoops.

Pray Farmstead(s)
It has an unloading chute and ladder with a corrugated metal surround and a metal silage distributor on its south side. It is 30 feet tall.
